details.note: Who you rely on for what you don't do yourself.
What you must do well every day to deliver the value propositions.
The people, places and things the business can't run without.
Why a customer picks you: the problem you solve for each segment.
How you win, keep and grow each segment.
How customers find you, buy from you and get what they paid for.
The groups you serve. Name them narrowly; two or three is plenty.
The biggest costs, fixed and variable, that the activities and resources create.
What each segment pays for, and how: per job, per item or per day.

name: Business model canvas
note: Replace each block's examples with your own. Start with Customer segments and Value propositions, then fill the blocks that deliver them. Finish with Cost structure and Revenue streams, and check that they add up.
